boards.title: Your First Weekend at Pepperdine University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: An under-21-safe first-weekend sequence that starts on the Malibu campus and leaves room for a daylight coastal outing.

cards.title: 1. Start with your orientation welcome group
cards.subtitle: New Student Orientation • Malibu campus
cards.notes: Introduce yourself to the orientation leaders and use the small-group activities as a low-pressure way to learn names and campus basics.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the organized welcome activity built into arrival.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine orientation leaders greet new students and lead small-group activities with them.
cards.access_notes: Follow the New Student Orientation schedule and directions provided by Pepperdine.

cards.title: 2. Get your bearings at Payson Library
cards.subtitle: Seaver College campus • 24255 Pacific Coast Highway
cards.notes: Walk through the flagship library, locate the exhibit gallery, and bookmark the service desk so you know where to begin when classes start.
cards.short_summary: Use a central campus landmark to orient yourself and find academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Payson Library is Pepperdine's flagship library at the heart of the Seaver College campus and includes an exhibit gallery and Genesis Lab.
cards.source_title: Locations, Hours, and Visitor Information | Pepperdine Libraries
cards.access_notes: Visitor access differs from current-student access; consult the library's current hours and visitor policy before visiting.

cards.title: 3. Pause at the Chapel on the Hill
cards.subtitle: Malibu campus • quiet reflection stop
cards.notes: Take a short, respectful pause for reflection or prayer, then use the campus map to connect this hilltop landmark to your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A quiet campus reset between the arrival rush and afternoon plans.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine describes Stauffer Chapel as a sacred space for worship, prayer, rest, and reflection and welcomes campus guests for short visits.
cards.source_title: The Chapel on the Hill | Pepperdine University
cards.access_notes: Treat the chapel as a shared quiet space and observe any posted access guidance.

cards.title: 4. See the Rock and its current messages
cards.subtitle: Student Activities tradition • Malibu campus
cards.notes: Stop to read the current painted announcements, then check Student Activities guidance before joining an organization that wants to paint it.
cards.short_summary: Meet campus organizations through an ongoing, documented visual tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine calls Painting the Rock a time-honored tradition used by student organizations to advertise events, celebrate accomplishments, and promote school spirit.
cards.access_notes: Painting is for student organizations; review the university's Rock guidelines before participating.

cards.title: 5. Take a daylight walk through Alumni Park
cards.subtitle: Malibu campus • recreation lawns and rolling hills
cards.notes: Use the paths and open lawn for a relaxed walk with new classmates, keeping clear of any organized recreation or club-sport activity.
cards.short_summary: A spacious on-campus stop for an unstructured conversation and a reset.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine describes Alumni Park as a 30-acre area of lawns, rolling hills, ponds, and coral trees used for recreational activities.
cards.access_notes: Yield to scheduled intramural and sport-club events in the level-field area.

cards.entity_name: Howard A. White Center lawn-game rentals
cards.title: 6. Borrow a lawn game from HAWC
cards.subtitle: Informal Recreation • Malibu campus
cards.notes: Ask the Howard A. White Center about available equipment, borrow a lawn game, and set up a casual game in an approved recreation area.
cards.short_summary: Turn a campus lawn into an easy, equipment-free group activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine's informal recreation program offers free sports-equipment and lawn-game rentals from the Howard A. White Center.
cards.access_notes: Confirm equipment availability and any checkout rules with Campus Recreation before borrowing.

cards.title: 7. Watch or play at the sand volleyball courts
cards.subtitle: Marie Canyon • Malibu campus
cards.notes: Bring a few classmates for a casual game or watch a practice from outside the playing area, giving teams priority when courts are in use.
cards.short_summary: A beach-volleyball stop with a clear campus recreation connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marie Canyon Sand Volleyball Courts have three sand courts, are home to Pepperdine women's and club beach volleyball, and are open to the public when not in team use.
cards.access_notes: Use the courts only when they are not being used by the listed teams; confirm availability locally.

cards.entity_name: Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art
cards.title: 8. Visit the Weisman Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: Lisa Smith Wengler Center for the Arts • Malibu campus
cards.notes: Choose one exhibition to see at an unhurried pace, then check the current museum page before heading over in case the schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus art stop that works well before an evening event.
cards.evidence_claim: The Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art is open Tuesday through Sunday from 11 AM to 5 PM, with free admission.
cards.source_title: About the Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art | Pepperdine
cards.access_notes: Current stated hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 11 AM–5 PM; it is also open until showtime on most Smothers Theatre performance days.

cards.title: 9. Check the home-game calendar at Firestone
cards.subtitle: Malibu campus • basketball and volleyball venue
cards.notes: Look for the next home contest, activate the student Access Pass if needed, and plan to arrive with classmates for a campus game.
cards.short_summary: Make a future game night part of your first-weekend plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Firestone Fieldhouse hosts Pepperdine men's and women's basketball home games and men's and women's volleyball home matches.
cards.access_notes: Check the current athletics schedule and activate Pepperdine's student Access Pass before attending a home event.

cards.title: 10. End with a sunset-timed walk at Malibu Bluffs Park
cards.subtitle: 24250 Pacific Coast Highway • beside Pepperdine
cards.notes: Go in daylight for the walking path and ocean outlook, use the posted park hours, and keep the outing simple with water and sun protection.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public-park finale with paths, picnic tables, and Pacific views.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Malibu lists Malibu Bluffs Park as a six-acre park overlooking the Pacific with a walking track, picnic areas, restrooms, and other recreation features.
cards.source_title: Malibu Bluffs Park | City of Malibu
cards.access_notes: The City lists daily hours as 8 AM to sunset; facilities or fields may be reserved, so check current conditions before relying on them.
